title: Master's Testament Letter
next_chapter_hook: As the remnant dissipated, another cold voice rang out from deep within Chen Ji's body: "You are merely my substitute. The position of Observer should have been mine."

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was gazing at the Tianji Diagram in a daze, an old yet familiar voice suddenly resounded from the void: "You've finally found this place, successor... This is the last letter left for you by the first Observer." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly coalesced into form, holding a yellowed ancient slip in his hand, the Dao patterns flowing upon it remarkably similar to the Tianji Record Fragment.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng solemnly placed the ancient slip before Chen Ji, a complex light flickering in his murky eyes: "I have waited eight hundred years for this day. Throughout these eight centuries, I witnessed countless geniuses rise and fall, yet only you have made it here."

Chen Ji accepted the ancient slip. The moment his fingertips touched the yellowed surface, a wave of warmth surged through his meridians into his Mental Sea. His expression remained unchanged, yet his heart churned like a turbulent sea—this sensation was identical to the Benefactor he had sensed in the secret realm.

"Master... he did not ascend." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly. "The first Observer chose to tear through dimensions of his own accord. He sealed a trace of his remnant within the Tianji Record, guarding this supreme treasure, waiting for the true successor to appear."

text.content: The Dao patterns on the ancient slip glowed slowly in Chen Ji's palm, those cryptic symbols automatically deciphering into meanings he could comprehend. Word by word, they were the first Observer's instructions spanning across time—and the information revealed within was enough to overturn all his previous understanding.

dialogue.content: "So the one who has been secretly helping me all along... was the first Observer from the very beginning?" Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze sharp as a blade. "Mo Xiansheng, why didn't you tell me earlier if you knew all this?"

Mo Xiansheng offered a bitter smile: "Because it was only today, when you truly touched the core of the Tianji Diagram, that this memory was unsealed for me. Master placed a restriction on me—I could say nothing until the appropriate moment."

text.content: The contents of the ancient slip unfolded slowly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. He saw the life of the first Observer—that person had once been the most mediocre mortal, yet due to a chance glimpse of Heavenly Secrets, embarked on the path of cultivation, eventually becoming the most powerful prophet in history. However, the price of divining Heavenly Secrets was far more terrifying than he could have imagined.

dialogue.content: "Your mission is not to replace Heaven's Mandate." That elderly yet gentle voice emerged from the ancient slip. "But to break the balance between Heaven's Mandate and dimensions, allowing the countless worlds devoured by Heaven's Mandate to regain their freedom."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. This answer was more astonishing than any possibility he had anticipated. Replacing Heaven's Mandate meant becoming a new ruler; yet breaking the balance... that meant becoming an enemy of the entire Will of Heaven's Mandate.

text.content: "The Turtle Shell Divine Artifact..." Chen Ji suddenly recalled the fragment in his怀. "What is its true nature?" Before he finished speaking, a sigh came from within the ancient slip: "That is a fragment that fell away when Master tore through dimensions—a land of purity forgotten by Heaven's Mandate."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng added: "The Turtle Shell Divine Artifact is no ordinary treasure. Within it lies an independent dimensional space. After Master departed, that space was gradually eroded by Heaven's Mandate, becoming the fragment you now hold. If it could be completely restored..."

"If it could be completely restored, a new world not controlled by Heaven's Mandate could be established right under its nose." Chen Ji took over, his voice ice-cold. "This is the fourth possibility—neither replacing nor surrendering, but completely subverting everything."

choice.prompt: The first Observer's final command lay before Chen Ji, forcing him to make a choice.

choices.description: Inherit the first Observer's will, formally stepping onto the path of breaking Heaven's Mandate's balance. This is a path no previous Observer has ever walked, and the most dangerous journey.
choices.visible_cost: Without Heaven's Mandate's protection, you may face the full-force pursuit of Heaven's Eye
choices.visible_reward: Obtain partial knowledge left by the first Observer, unlock the method to repair the dimensional fragment
choices.risk_hint: Heaven's Eye will perceive your ambitions earlier

text.content: The ancient slip shattered with a thunderous crash, transforming into golden light that pierced Chen Ji's Brow Center. In an instant, countless obscure insights flooded his Mental Sea like a tide—that was the ultimate mystery concerning dimensions, the essence of Heaven's Mandate, and how to repair the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact.

choices.description: What right did the first Observer have to decide his destiny? Chen Ji needed to unravel all the truths from the beginning—the Benefactor's guidance, the trajectory of fate, and his true free will.
choices.visible_cost: May anger the remnant, losing partial inherited knowledge
choices.visible_reward: Press for deeper truths: the real secrets behind the Observer's legacy
choices.risk_hint: The remnant may thus retract some of its assistance

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gripped the ancient slip in his hand, his gaze icy cold: "The first Observer tore through dimensions and left, but left the mess for me? Why should I complete his unfinished business? What does his final command have to do with me?"

choices.description: Neither accepting the command nor questioning it, but re-examining everything from a higher dimension—carving out one's own path, a brand new possibility transcending all previous Observers.
choices.visible_cost: Creating this path requires a massive consumption of Heavenly Fate, and the probability of success is unknown
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a unique "Fourth Path" status, unlocking unprecedented cultivation methods
choices.risk_hint: Heaven's Eye will regard you as the greatest threat

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed—that smile carried a hint of madness and resolve: "The first Observer's path is not my path. I will walk the fourth—one that belongs to neither Heaven's Mandate nor dimensions, but a brand new order rising above both."
Chen Ji's choice caused Mo Xiansheng's expression to shift slightly. Gazing at this former废物, an inexplicable emotion surged in his heart—reverence, gratification, and a deep trace of worry.

dialogue.content: "Successor, whatever choice you make..." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul began fading. "There is one thing I must tell you in the end. That Benefactor's remnant has completed its mission. But within you, there is another thing..."

Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly: "What thing?" Mo Xiansheng's voice grew increasingly faint: "Another consciousness within you... born with you, resonating with the Tianji Record. He has been waiting for the opportune moment, waiting for the chance to replace you..."

text.content: Before he could finish, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul dissolved completely, scattering into specks of starlight融入 into the ancient slip's remnants. Silence fell all around, yet the fragments of the ancient slip in Chen Ji's palm remained faintly warm. He lowered his gaze toward his chest—a诡异 pulsation was emanating from there.

dialogue.content: "So that's how it is..." Chen Ji murmured to himself, his voice cold enough to freeze. "No wonder every time I used the Tianji Record, I felt being watched. So from the very beginning, an uninvited guest has been residing within me."

text.content: Just then, a cold voice rang out from deep within Chen Ji. That voice was identical to his own, yet carried an indescribable arrogance and venom: "You've finally discovered it, substitute. Eight hundred years of waiting, countless resources piled up... The position of Observer should have been mine."

dialogue.content: A cold smile curled at Chen Ji's lips: "So you are the successor the Benefactor truly wanted to select? Manipulated by Heaven's Eye for eight hundred years, yet you vent your anger on me?" He rose, killing intent blazing in his eyes. "Fine, then let's see who is the real substitute."

text.content: Before the words even finished echoing, a shrill alarm suddenly sounded in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. He glanced down at his chest—a pitch-black pattern was slowly spreading there. That was the trace left by a conflict between the Tianji Record and some foreign consciousness. The gears of fate had already begun turning. The next instant, a crack suddenly tore open in the void, and a yellowed ancient slip floated out from the rift—on its surface flowing Dao patterns remarkably similar to the Tianji Record Fragment...
